source.title: Dynamic Changes of Reproductive Hormones in Male Minipuberty: Temporal Dissociation of Leydig and Sertoli Cell Activity
source.license: Article all rights reserved; extracted concentrations are factual readings, not republication of artwork; author-provided supplements are CC BY 4.0.

statistic: Approximate GAMLSS age-specific median (Figure 3 black curve), NOT arithmetic mean or Figure 2 longitudinal mean.
method: Read cubic Bezier paths from PDF, fit linear age/concentration axes to all labeled ticks, solve x coordinate by bisection; no secondary smoothing.
use: Candidate numerical basis for educational patient-dot mockup; not a validated diagnostic reference or percentile calculator. No extrapolation to birth, preterm infants, childhood or puberty.
limitations: Author numerical LMS/GAMLSS coefficient tables were not found; typography-derived numbers are approximate.
Do not replace current longitudinal mean-shaped schematic with these medians without explaining that population median and longitudinal mean can differ.
LOD/LOQ-censored median must remain censored; do not report ratios to an artificial floor.
Methods are assay-specific; cross-assay transfer has not been validated.
INSL3 Methods unit conflicts with Figure 3 and Table S1; retain ug/L and flag author confirmation before clinical use.

fsh.assay: AutoDELFIA time-resolved fluoroimmunometric assay, PerkinElmer B017-201
fsh.clinicalReferenceBlockReason: Digitized curve, no author model coefficients; no validated clinical decision or percentile use.
fsh.floorRule: Conservative DISPLAY heuristic only: approximate median minus (graphical half-stroke plus calibration residual) must remain >= LOD/LOQ. Otherwise do not calculate a ratio-to-median or precise relative dot. Not a clinical cutoff or author source rule; raw concentration remains unchanged.
fsh.belowLodPresentation: Median below assay detection/quantification; retain inequality, not exact floor or zero.

calibration.note: Half-stroke concentration is graphical reading scale only, not biological/model uncertainty.
